title: Hearty Dense Syrian Lamb Kebabs
description: A festive Syrian dish featuring ground annatto and tandoor, these lamb kebabs are winey, dense, and low-glycemic-friendly. Perfect for special occasions or gatherings.
instructions: Preheat the tandoor or oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, combine the ground lamb, ground annatto, red wine, olive oil, garlic, onion, salt, and black pepper.
Mix the ingredients together with your hands or a wooden spoon until just combined.
Cover the bowl with plastic wrap and refrigerate for at least 30 minutes to allow the flavors to meld.
Thread the lamb mixture onto skewers, leaving a small space between each piece.
Place the skewers in the tandoor or oven and cook for 15-20 minutes, or until the lamb is cooked through.
Serve the kebabs hot, garnished with fresh parsley or cilantro.
Traditionally, these kebabs are served with a side of bulgur or rice.
You can also serve with a simple salad or roasted vegetables.
